title: PayToView
tagline: A tool that helps users create pay-to-view NFTs and share links.
description: A tool that helps users post pay-to-view NFTs for encrypted content. The tool creates an h5 page for the user. The h5 page contains a contract, which is also an nft. It saves the partial content of the preview, the complete encrypted content, the cost of viewing the content, and other parameters. The link to the h5 page can be shared within browser. Click the link to watch the preview. If you are interested in the content, you can pay to watch the complete content.
how_its_made: The project uses the AES algorithm to encrypt and save the content shared by users. The shared content is stored in IPFS, and filecoin is used to ensure the validity of the data. The smart contract uses FVM and runs on the TVN network. TVN network is a web3 infrastructure based on IPFS and DKVS, which is used to simplify the development and operation of web3 applications. It can be considered as an L3 application network and can be connected to any public chain.
